name: spool-media
description: Spool launch video (Remotion). Assets in public/ are generated by prepare.py from fictional screenshots and are not committed.

scripts.shorts: remotion render SpoolShort1 out/shorts/raw-1.mkv --crf=14 --audio-codec=pcm-16 && remotion render SpoolShort2 out/shorts/raw-2.mkv --crf=14 --audio-codec=pcm-16 && remotion render SpoolShort3 out/shorts/raw-3.mkv --crf=14 --audio-codec=pcm-16 && python finish.py shorts
scripts.covers: remotion still SpoolShort1 out/shorts/spool-short-1-catalogue.jpg --frame=38 --image-format=jpeg --jpeg-quality=90 && remotion still SpoolShort2 out/shorts/spool-short-2-files.jpg --frame=38 --image-format=jpeg --jpeg-quality=90 && remotion still SpoolShort3 out/shorts/spool-short-3-themes.jpg --frame=38 --image-format=jpeg --jpeg-quality=90
